verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee documents premium_proxy and stealth_proxy-related features (e.g., infinite_scroll incompatibility with stealth_proxy implies a stealth mode exists) and premium proxies to bypass difficult-to-scrape sites, indicating anti-bot capability, but there is no explicit first-party description of a dedicated 'undetected browser' mode or fingerprint-evasion mechanism, and no independent/hands-on evidence confirming effectiveness against sophisticated bot detection. missing for 10: explicit documentation of an undetected/stealth browser mode's mechanics, independent hands-on verification of bypassing sophisticated bot detection systems.
